entities.summary: Burghölzli, named after the wooded hill in the district of Riesbach in southeastern Zürich where it is located, is the Psychiatrische Universitätsklinik Zürich, a psychiatric hospital in Switzerland. As a research hospital, it is associated with the University of Zürich. Psychiatrische Universitätsklinik Zürich is a hospital in Europe, established in 1870. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
